split_built.prototype_definition: AFLOW-style: (space group number, anonymized reduced stoichiometry, sorted per-element Wyckoff (multiplicity,letter) multiset); element identities anonymized so isostructural compounds share a prototype
split_built.contrast: controlled complement of data/e3: same sizes, balance, renders, labels; data/e3 withholds CHEMISTRY, this withholds GEOMETRY

blocker_found.issue: 189/210 (90.0%) of data/e3proto/eval sits in data/e3 TRAIN, i.e. the existing checkpoints were trained on it
blocker_found.consequence: evaluating existing checkpoints on the built split would mostly measure memorization of SEEN structures; the clean test requires RETRAINING on data/e3proto/train, which is NOT done and NOT claimed

probe_run.name: double-OOD subset
probe_run.definition: data/e3 eval structures whose PROTOTYPE is also absent from data/e3 train -> simultaneously composition-OOD (unseen element) and prototype-OOD (unseen arrangement) w.r.t. what the checkpoints trained on
probe_run.caveat: unbalanced and contains NO cubic (the easiest system), which lowers all arms' absolute numbers; therefore only the WITHIN-ARM DELTA is interpreted
probe_run.cost: zero new generation — stratified re-scoring of existing predictions

BRANCH_TAKEN: (iii) — ALL ARMS DROP TOGETHER (every magnitude > the pre-registered 0.05 threshold: B1 -0.0560, SFT-V1 -0.0632, B3 -0.0633, V2a -0.1232, V2b -0.1287). Branch (ii) required B1 to hold WITHIN 0.05 and 0.0560 exceeds it. Per the pre-registration this is a DIFFICULTY SHIFT and must NOT be read as evidence about memorization; only arm ORDERING may be compared.
consequence: the CP1b question REMAINS OPEN — neither confirmed nor refuted by this probe. Arm ORDERING does NOT survive intact: full eval is B1 0.6143 > V2b 0.3857 > V2a 0.3762 > SFT-V1 0.3524 > B3 0.3444, but double-OOD is B1 0.5583 > SFT-V1 0.2892 > B3 0.2811 > V2b 0.2570 > V2a 0.2530 — both PROCESS arms fall BELOW SFT-V1 and B3, a rank inversion that is the same fact as their >2x larger drops. What survives: B1 remains first by +0.269 over the next arm on the subset, so CP1b's branch (a) is not disturbed. CP3's Gate-2 ordering (process > outcome) DOES invert here, and under branch (iii) that cannot be read as a memorization/generalization result — it is confounded with the subset being harder for every arm. Arbitrating requires the clean retrained test on data/e3proto (built and audited, not run) or a difficulty-matched geometric-OOD subset.
secondary_observation_NOT_established: under branch (iii) the subset is harder for every arm, so this is a DIFFERENTIAL SENSITIVITY observation and NOT a geometric-OOD mechanism: both process arms degrade ~2x more than the outcome arm and the SFT baseline (-0.123/-0.129 vs -0.063/-0.063). NOT established: n=83, single split, no SFT-V1 seeds, per-arm contamination differs, and no memorization reading is licensed. Flagged for the retrain.
correction: This file originally recorded BRANCH (ii) 'B1 HOLDS' and concluded the CP1b robustness finding STRENGTHENS and the IID-in-decisive-feature explanation was NOT SUFFICIENT. That violated the pre-registered rule: 0.0560 > 0.050. Corrected to branch (iii); the memorization-relevant conclusions are RETRACTED. Pre-correction finding text preserved in finding_prebranchfix_snapshot.md. SECOND CORRECTION: this file also claimed arm ordering was 'unchanged' on the subset. FALSE — V2a and V2b invert below SFT-V1 and B3. Corrected above with both orderings listed.

ordering.inversion: both process arms (V2a, V2b) fall below SFT-V1 and B3 on the double-OOD subset
ordering.survives: B1 first in both, by +0.2286 (full) and +0.269 (subset)

post_hoc_stratified_analysis.STATUS: EXPLORATORY AND POST-HOC — designed AFTER the pre-registered analysis returned branch (iii), specifically to remove the difficulty confound. Labelled, not promoted.
post_hoc_stratified_analysis.design: the 210 eval structures split into 83 prototype-OOD + 127 prototype-IID, BOTH composition-OOD by construction; effect = mean over the 6 systems with >=5 structures on both sides of (acc on prototype-OOD - acc on prototype-IID), equal weight per system. Cubic dropped (0 prototype-OOD).
post_hoc_stratified_analysis.tempting_read_NOT_supported: on point estimates this resembles pre-registered branch (i): B1 is the only arm exceeding the 0.05 threshold (-0.0856) while every chain/process arm sits at -0.013 to -0.035, and B1's gap to V2b (0.0563) exceeds B1's seed SD (0.0299). That would mean B1's robustness is chemistry-specific. IT DOES NOT SURVIVE ERROR BARS: with n=6 systems the system-to-system spread (0.04-0.19) swamps every effect (0.01-0.09) and NO arm reaches |t|>1.8 (B1 t=-1.63).
post_hoc_stratified_analysis.CONCLUSION: HONEST NULL — underpowered. Neither rescues branch (i) nor strengthens branch (iii). Two independent analyses now fail to resolve the CP1b question, which is itself the finding: THIS DATA CANNOT SETTLE IT. Requires the clean retrain on data/e3proto, or a geometric-OOD eval set built system-balanced on BOTH sides.
post_hoc_stratified_analysis.DO_NOT_CITE: the -0.0856 vs -0.029 contrast — it is a point estimate with t=-1.63
